preToolUse.bash: TOOL_NAME="$COPILOT_HOOK_TOOL_NAME"; TOOL_ARGS="$COPILOT_HOOK_TOOL_ARGS"; if echo "$TOOL_ARGS" | grep -qE '(rm -rf /|rm -rf \*|rm -rf ~)'; then echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "Dangerous rm -rf command blocked by security hook"}'; elif echo "$TOOL_ARGS" | grep -qE '(password|secret|api_key|token)' && echo "$TOOL_NAME" | grep -q 'write'; then echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "Potential secret exposure blocked. Do not write credentials to files."}'; elif echo "$TOOL_ARGS" | grep -qE 'git push --force'; then echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "Force push is not allowed. Use regular git push."}'; elif echo "$TOOL_ARGS" | grep -qE 'curl.*\| *(sh|bash)'; then echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "Piping remote scripts to shell is not allowed."}'; else echo '{"decision": "allow"}'; fi
